presenter_video_override.binding: optional storyboard.presenterVideo; same source video byte-copy; new native queue request
presenter_video_override.coverage: all merged presenter intervals only; reject omissions, cross-scene coverage, repeated source and insufficient duration
presenter_video_override.clock: 30fps sourceOffsetFrames in editing clock; natural source-time sampling; original audio master and AV EDL retained
presenter_video_override.fallback: omitted override keeps original AV source; present override must cover every presenter interval

operations.input: 完整源MP4、真实cue、EDL、storyboard、声音计划与本期授权
operations.output: 新冻结request、同1350帧成片及同SHA技术/视觉记录
operations.completion: 真实完整输出与素材、字幕、声音检查分别完成；旧样片不代替新范围
operations.recovery: 复用原付费素材，保留原request与队列，局部修订新prepare
